title: A.e. weighted approximate tangent planes and measurability of tangentProj (Simon Ch. 3, 1.2-1.9)
statement: Let n >= 1, l >= 0, U an open subset of R^(n+l), and V = v(M, theta) a RectifiableVarifold n l U: M ⊆ U is H^n-null-measurable and countably n-rectifiable, theta > 0 on M, theta is a.e. measurable for H^n restricted to M, and the integral of theta over M ∩ K is finite for every compact K ⊆ U. Let mu = V.weight = (H^n restricted to M) with density theta and p_x = V.tangentProj x. Then (a) x -> p_x is mu-a.e. strongly measurable; (b) for mu-a.e. x there is a linear subspace T of R^(n+l) which is an approximate tangent space of M with respect to theta at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, Def. 1.7 (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M theta x T, which includes dim T = n), and p_x = T.starProjection is the orthogonal projection onto T.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), AEStronglyMeasurable V.tangentProj V.weight ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ T : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n V.carrier V.mult x T ∧ V.tangentProj x = T.starProjection
